Package com.saicone.nbt.io

Class TagReader<T>

java.lang.Object
java.io.Reader
com.saicone.nbt.io.TagReader<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the tag object implementation.
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable, Readable
public class TagReader<T> extends Reader
Reads SNBT formated tag objects from delegated reader.
The compatible format aims to be the same as Minecraft.
